def BFloat16 : Type := Fin 65536

namespace BFloat16

def fromBits (bits : UInt16) : BFloat16 :=
  ⟨bits.toNat % 65536, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def toBits (bf : BFloat16) : UInt16 :=
  UInt16.ofNat bf.val

def fromFloatImpl (f : Float) : BFloat16 :=
  if f.isNaN then
    fromBits 32704
  else if f == Float.inf then
    fromBits 32640
  else if f == -Float.inf then
    fromBits 65408
  else
    let bits : Nat := f.toUInt32.toNat
    let rounded : Nat := bits + 32768
    ⟨(rounded / 65536) % 65536, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def toFloatImpl (bf : BFloat16) : Float :=
  Float.ofUInt32 (UInt32.ofNat (bf.val * 65536))

end BFloat16

def Vec (α : Type) (n : Nat) := Fin n → α

namespace Vec

def get (v : Vec α n) (i : Fin n) : α :=
  v i

def set (v : Vec α n) (i : Fin n) (a : α) : Vec α n :=
  fun j => if j = i then a else v j

def zeros (n : Nat) : Vec Float n :=
  fun _ => 0.0

def ones (n : Nat) : Vec Float n :=
  fun _ => 1.0

def const (n : Nat) (val : Float) : Vec Float n :=
  fun _ => val

def sum (v : Vec Float n) : Float :=
  (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + v i) 0.0

def sumSquares (v : Vec Float n) : Float :=
  (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + v i * v i) 0.0

def dot (v1 v2 : Vec Float n) : Float :=
  (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + v1 i * v2 i) 0.0

end Vec

def sqrt (x : Float) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt x

def rsqrt (x : Float) : Float :=
  1.0 / sqrt x

def exp (x : Float) : Float :=
  Float.exp x

def tanh (x : Float) : Float :=
  Float.tanh x

def erf (x : Float) : Float :=
  Float.erf x

def isFinite (x : Float) : Prop :=
  x ≠ Float.inf ∧ x ≠ -Float.inf ∧ ¬x.isNaN

def maxFloat (x y : Float) : Float :=
  if x ≥ y then x else y

def minFloat (x y : Float) : Float :=
  if x ≤ y then x else y

def rmsNormForwardSpec (input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Vec Float n :=
  let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
  let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
  let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
  let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
  fun i => input i * rsqrtVal * weight i

theorem rmsNormForwardSpec_apply (input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    rmsNormForwardSpec input weight eps hN hEps i =
      let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
      let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
      let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
      let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
      input i * rsqrtVal * weight i := by
  rfl

def rmsNormBackwardSpec (gradOutput input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Vec Float n × Vec Float n :=
  let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
  let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
  let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
  let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
  let rsqrtCubed := rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal
  let sumGWX := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + gradOutput i * weight i * input i) 0.0
  let nF := Float.ofNat n
  let gradInput := fun i => weight i * rsqrtVal * gradOutput i - input i * sumGWX * rsqrtCubed / nF
  let gradWeight := fun i => gradOutput i * input i * rsqrtVal
  (gradInput, gradWeight)

theorem rmsNormBackwardSpec_grad_input_def (gradOutput input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    (rmsNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight eps hN hEps).1 i =
      let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
      let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
      let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
      let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
      let rsqrtCubed := rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal
      let sumGWX := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc j => acc + gradOutput j * weight j * input j) 0.0
      weight i * rsqrtVal * gradOutput i - input i * sumGWX * rsqrtCubed / Float.ofNat n := by
  rfl

theorem rmsNormBackwardSpec_grad_weight_def (gradOutput input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    (rmsNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight eps hN hEps).2 i =
      let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
      let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
      let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
      let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
      gradOutput i * input i * rsqrtVal := by
  rfl

def layerNormForwardSpec (input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Vec Float n :=
  let sumVal := Vec.sum input
  let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
  let nF := Float.ofNat n
  let mean := sumVal / nF
  let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
  let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
  let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
  let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
  fun i =>
    let centered := input i - mean
    let normalized := centered * invStd
    normalized * weight i + bias i

theorem layerNormForwardSpec_apply (input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    layerNormForwardSpec input weight bias eps hN hEps i =
      let sumVal := Vec.sum input
      let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
      let nF := Float.ofNat n
      let mean := sumVal / nF
      let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
      let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
      let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
      let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
      let centered := input i - mean
      let normalized := centered * invStd
      normalized * weight i + bias i := by
  rfl

def layerNormBackwardSpec (gradOutput input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Vec Float n × Vec Float n × Vec Float n :=
  let sumVal := Vec.sum input
  let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
  let nF := Float.ofNat n
  let mean := sumVal / nF
  let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
  let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
  let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
  let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
  let sumGrad := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + gradOutput i * weight i) 0.0
  let sumGradCentered := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + gradOutput i * weight i * (input i - mean)) 0.0
  let gradInput := fun i =>
    let centered := input i - mean
    let term1 := gradOutput i * weight i * invStd
    let term2 := sumGrad * invStd / nF
    let term3 := centered * sumGradCentered * invStd * invStd * invStd / nF
    term1 - term2 - term3
  let gradWeight := fun i =>
    let centered := input i - mean
    gradOutput i * centered * invStd
  let gradBias := gradOutput
  (gradInput, gradWeight, gradBias)

theorem layerNormBackwardSpec_grad_input_def (gradOutput input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    (layerNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight bias eps hN hEps).1 i =
      let sumVal := Vec.sum input
      let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
      let nF := Float.ofNat n
      let mean := sumVal / nF
      let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
      let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
      let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
      let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
      let sumGrad := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc j => acc + gradOutput j * weight j) 0.0
      let sumGradCentered := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc j => acc + gradOutput j * weight j * (input j - mean)) 0.0
      let centered := input i - mean
      let term1 := gradOutput i * weight i * invStd
      let term2 := sumGrad * invStd / nF
      let term3 := centered * sumGradCentered * invStd * invStd * invStd / nF
      term1 - term2 - term3 := by
  rfl

theorem layerNormBackwardSpec_grad_weight_def (gradOutput input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    (layerNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight bias eps hN hEps).2 i =
      let sumVal := Vec.sum input
      let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
      let nF := Float.ofNat n
      let mean := sumVal / nF
      let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
      let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
      let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
      let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
      let centered := input i - mean
      gradOutput i * centered * invStd := by
  rfl

theorem layerNormBackwardSpec_grad_bias_def (gradOutput input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    (layerNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight bias eps hN hEps).3 i = gradOutput i := by

def geluApproximateSpec (x : Float) : Float :=
  let sqrt2OverPi : Float := 0.7978845608028653559
  let coeff0044715 : Float := 0.0447149984538555145
  let x3 := x * x * x
  let inner := sqrt2OverPi * (x + coeff0044715 * x3)
  let tanhVal := tanh inner
  0.5 * x * (1.0 + tanhVal)

def geluExactSpec (x : Float) : Float :=
  let sqrt2 : Float := 1.4142135623730950488
  let erfVal := erf (x / sqrt2)
  0.5 * x * (1.0 + erfVal)

def geluApproximateDerivativeSpec (x : Float) : Float :=
  let sqrt2OverPi : Float := 0.7978845608028653559
  let coeff0044715 : Float := 0.0447149984538555145
  let coeff3044715 : Float := 0.1341449953616565435
  let x2 := x * x
  let x3 := x2 * x
  let tanhArg := sqrt2OverPi * (x + coeff0044715 * x3)
  let tanhVal := tanh tanhArg
  let sechSq := 1.0 - tanhVal * tanhVal
  let innerDeriv := sqrt2OverPi * (1.0 + coeff3044715 * x2)
  0.5 * (1.0 + tanhVal) + 0.5 * x * sechSq * innerDeriv

def geluExactDerivativeSpec (x : Float) : Float :=
  let sqrt2 : Float := 1.4142135623730950488
  let invSqrt2Pi : Float := 0.3989422804014326779
  let cdf := 0.5 * (1.0 + erf (x / sqrt2))
  let pdf := exp (-0.5 * x * x) * invSqrt2Pi
  cdf + x * pdf

def geluForwardSpec (input : Vec Float n) (approximate : Bool) : Vec Float n :=
  if approximate then
    fun i => geluApproximateSpec (input i)
  else
    fun i => geluExactSpec (input i)

def geluBackwardSpec (gradOutput input : Vec Float n) (approximate : Bool) : Vec Float n :=
  if approximate then
    fun i => gradOutput i * geluApproximateDerivativeSpec (input i)
  else
    fun i => gradOutput i * geluExactDerivativeSpec (input i)

theorem geluForwardSpec_apply_true (input : Vec Float n) (i : Fin n) :
    geluForwardSpec input true i = geluApproximateSpec (input i) := by
  simp [geluForwardSpec]

theorem geluForwardSpec_apply_false (input : Vec Float n) (i : Fin n) :
    geluForwardSpec input false i = geluExactSpec (input i) := by
  simp [geluForwardSpec]

theorem geluBackwardSpec_apply_true (gradOutput input : Vec Float n) (i : Fin n) :
    geluBackwardSpec gradOutput input true i = gradOutput i * geluApproximateDerivativeSpec (input i) := by
  simp [geluBackwardSpec]

theorem geluBackwardSpec_apply_false (gradOutput input : Vec Float n) (i : Fin n) :
    geluBackwardSpec gradOutput input false i = gradOutput i * geluExactDerivativeSpec (input i) := by
  simp [geluBackwardSpec]

def softmaxForwardSpec (input : Vec Float n) (hN : n > 0) : Vec Float n :=
  let maxVal := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => maxFloat acc (input i)) (-Float.inf)
  let expVals := fun i => exp (input i - maxVal)
  let sumExp := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + expVals i) 0.0
  if sumExp = 0.0 ∨ ¬isFinite sumExp then
    fun _ => 1.0 / Float.ofNat n
  else
    fun i => expVals i / sumExp

def softmaxBackwardSpec (gradOutput output : Vec Float n) (hN : n > 0) : Vec Float n :=
  let dotProduct := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + output i * gradOutput i) 0.0
  fun i => output i * (gradOutput i - dotProduct)

theorem softmaxBackwardSpec_apply (gradOutput output : Vec Float n) (hN : n > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    softmaxBackwardSpec gradOutput output hN i =
      let dotProduct := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc j => acc + output j * gradOutput j) 0.0
      output i * (gradOutput i - dotProduct) := by
  rfl

def rmsNormForwardImpl (input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Except NormError (Vec Float n) :=
  if h0 : n = 0 then
    Except.error NormError.invalidNormalizedShape
  else
    let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
    let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
    let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
    if hBad : denom = 0 ∨ ¬isFinite denom then
      Except.error NormError.numericalInstability
    else
      let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
      Except.ok (fun i => input i * rsqrtVal * weight i)

theorem rmsNormForwardImpl_matches_spec (input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0)
    (hFinite : let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
               let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
               let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
               denom ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite denom) :
    rmsNormForwardImpl input weight eps hN hEps = Except.ok (rmsNormForwardSpec input weight eps hN hEps) := by
  have hN0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have hBad :
      ¬(let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
         let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
         let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
         denom = 0 ∨ ¬isFinite denom) := by
    simpa [not_or] using hFinite
  simp [rmsNormForwardImpl, rmsNormForwardSpec, hN0, hBad]

def rmsNormBackwardImpl (gradOutput input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Except NormError (Vec Float n × Vec Float n) :=
  if h0 : n = 0 then
    Except.error NormError.invalidNormalizedShape
  else
    let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
    let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
    let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
    if hBad : denom = 0 ∨ ¬isFinite denom then
      Except.error NormError.numericalInstability
    else
      let rsqrtVal := 1.0 / denom
      let rsqrtCubed := rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal * rsqrtVal
      let sumGWX := (List.finRange n).foldl (fun acc i => acc + gradOutput i * weight i * input i) 0.0
      let nF := Float.ofNat n
      let gradInput := fun i => weight i * rsqrtVal * gradOutput i - input i * sumGWX * rsqrtCubed / nF
      let gradWeight := fun i => gradOutput i * input i * rsqrtVal
      Except.ok (gradInput, gradWeight)

theorem rmsNormBackwardImpl_matches_spec (gradOutput input weight : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0)
    (hFinite : let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
               let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
               let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
               denom ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite denom) :
    rmsNormBackwardImpl gradOutput input weight eps hN hEps =
      Except.ok (rmsNormBackwardSpec gradOutput input weight eps hN hEps) := by
  have hN0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hN
  have hBad :
      ¬(let sumSq := Vec.sumSquares input
         let meanSq := sumSq / Float.ofNat n
         let denom := sqrt (meanSq + eps)
         denom = 0 ∨ ¬isFinite denom) := by
    simpa [not_or] using hFinite
  simp [rmsNormBackwardImpl, rmsNormBackwardSpec, hN0, hBad]

def layerNormForwardImpl (input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0) : Except NormError (Vec Float n) :=
  if h0 : n = 0 then
    Except.error NormError.invalidNormalizedShape
  else
    let sumVal := Vec.sum input
    let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input
    let nF := Float.ofNat n
    let mean := sumVal / nF
    let meanSq := sumSqVal / nF
    let varianceUnclamped := meanSq - mean * mean
    let variance := maxFloat 0.0 varianceUnclamped
    let invStd := 1.0 / sqrt (variance + eps)
    if hBad : ¬isFinite invStd then
      Except.error NormError.numericalInstability
    else
      Except.ok (fun i => (input i - mean) * invStd * weight i + bias i)

theorem layerNormForwardImpl_matches_spec (input weight bias : Vec Float n) (eps : Float)
    (hN : n > 0) (hEps : eps > 0)
    (hFinite : let sumVal := Vec.sum input
               let sumSqVal := Vec.sumSquares input

    if (grad_input.len != grad_output.len) return GELUError.SizeMismatch;

    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < grad_output.len) : (i += 1) {
        const x = input[i].toFloat();
        const g = grad_output[i].toFloat();
        const deriv = if (approximate) geluApproximateDerivative(x) else geluExactDerivative(x);
        grad_input[i] = BFloat16.fromFloat(g * deriv);
    }
}

pub fn softmaxForward(
    input: []const BFloat16,
    output: []BFloat16,
    outer_size: usize,
    dim_size: usize,
    inner_size: usize,
) SoftmaxError!void {
    if (outer_size == 0 or inner_size == 0) return;
    if (dim_size == 0) return SoftmaxError.ZeroDimension;

    const total_size = checkedMul3(outer_size, dim_size, inner_size) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions;
    if (input.len != total_size) return SoftmaxError.SizeMismatch;
    if (output.len != total_size) return SoftmaxError.SizeMismatch;

    var outer: usize = 0;
    while (outer < outer_size) : (outer += 1) {
        var inner: usize = 0;
        while (inner < inner_size) : (inner += 1) {
            const base_offset = checkedAdd((checkedMul(outer, dim_size * inner_size) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions), inner) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions;

            var max_val: f32 = -math.inf(f32);
            var d: usize = 0;
            while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                const v = input[idx].toFloat();
                if (v > max_val) max_val = v;
            }

            if (!math.isFinite(max_val)) return SoftmaxError.NumericalInstability;

            var sum_exp: f64 = 0.0;
            d = 0;
            while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                const v: f64 = @floatCast(input[idx].toFloat());
                const shifted = v - @as(f64, @floatCast(max_val));
                sum_exp += math.exp(shifted);
            }

            if (sum_exp == 0.0 or !math.isFinite(sum_exp)) {
                const uniform: f32 = 1.0 / @as(f32, @floatFromInt(dim_size));
                d = 0;
                while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                    const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                    output[idx] = BFloat16.fromFloat(uniform);
                }
            } else {
                d = 0;
                while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                    const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                    const v: f64 = @floatCast(input[idx].toFloat());
                    const shifted = v - @as(f64, @floatCast(max_val));
                    const y: f32 = @floatCast(math.exp(shifted) / sum_exp);
                    output[idx] = BFloat16.fromFloat(y);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn softmaxBackward(
    grad_output: []const BFloat16,
    output: []const BFloat16,
    grad_input: []BFloat16,
    outer_size: usize,
    dim_size: usize,
    inner_size: usize,
) SoftmaxError!void {
    if (outer_size == 0 or inner_size == 0) return;
    if (dim_size == 0) return SoftmaxError.ZeroDimension;

    const total_size = checkedMul3(outer_size, dim_size, inner_size) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions;
    if (grad_output.len != total_size) return SoftmaxError.SizeMismatch;
    if (output.len != total_size) return SoftmaxError.SizeMismatch;
    if (grad_input.len != total_size) return SoftmaxError.SizeMismatch;

    var outer: usize = 0;
    while (outer < outer_size) : (outer += 1) {
        var inner: usize = 0;
        while (inner < inner_size) : (inner += 1) {
            const base_offset = checkedAdd((checkedMul(outer, dim_size * inner_size) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions), inner) orelse return SoftmaxError.InvalidDimensions;

            var dot_product: f64 = 0.0;
            var d: usize = 0;
            while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                const s: f64 = @floatCast(output[idx].toFloat());
                const g: f64 = @floatCast(grad_output[idx].toFloat());
                dot_product += s * g;
            }

            d = 0;
            while (d < dim_size) : (d += 1) {
                const idx = base_offset + d * inner_size;
                const s: f64 = @floatCast(output[idx].toFloat());
                const g: f64 = @floatCast(grad_output[idx].toFloat());
                grad_input[idx] = BFloat16.fromFloat(@floatCast(s * (g - dot_product)));
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn softmaxForward1D(input: []const BFloat16, output: []BFloat16) SoftmaxError!void {
    if (input.len == 0) return;

    try softmaxForward(input, output, 1, input.len, 1);
}

pub fn softmaxBackward1D(

}

pub fn rmsNormForwardStrided(
    input: []const BFloat16,
    weight: []const BFloat16,
    output: []BFloat16,
    n_rows: usize,
    normalized_shape: usize,
    input_row_stride: usize,
    output_row_stride: usize,
    eps: f32,
) NormError!void {
    if (normalized_shape == 0) return NormError.InvalidNormalizedShape;
    if (n_rows == 0) return;
    if (weight.len != normalized_shape) return NormError.SizeMismatch;

    const needed_input = requiredStridedLen(n_rows, input_row_stride, normalized_shape) orelse return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    const needed_output = requiredStridedLen(n_rows, output_row_stride, normalized_shape) orelse return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    if (input.len < needed_input) return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    if (output.len < needed_output) return NormError.SizeMismatch;

    const eps_f64: f64 = @floatCast(eps);
    if (!(eps_f64 > 0.0)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;

    const n_f64: f64 = @floatFromInt(normalized_shape);

    var row: usize = 0;
    while (row < n_rows) : (row += 1) {
        const input_row_start = row * input_row_stride;
        const output_row_start = row * output_row_stride;

        var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < normalized_shape) : (i += 1) {
            const x: f64 = @floatCast(input[input_row_start + i].toFloat());
            sum_sq += x * x;
        }

        const mean_sq = sum_sq / n_f64;
        const denom = math.sqrt(mean_sq + eps_f64);
        if (denom == 0.0 or !math.isFinite(denom)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;

        const rsqrt_val = 1.0 / denom;

        i = 0;
        while (i < normalized_shape) : (i += 1) {
            const x: f64 = @floatCast(input[input_row_start + i].toFloat());
            const w: f64 = @floatCast(weight[i].toFloat());
            const y = x * rsqrt_val * w;
            if (!math.isFinite(y)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;
            output[output_row_start + i] = BFloat16.fromFloat(@floatCast(y));
        }
    }
}

pub fn layerNormForwardStrided(
    input: []const BFloat16,
    weight: []const BFloat16,
    bias: ?[]const BFloat16,
    output: []BFloat16,
    n_rows: usize,
    normalized_shape: usize,
    input_row_stride: usize,
    output_row_stride: usize,
    eps: f32,
) NormError!void {
    if (normalized_shape == 0) return NormError.InvalidNormalizedShape;
    if (n_rows == 0) return;
    if (weight.len != normalized_shape) return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    if (bias) |b| {
        if (b.len != normalized_shape) return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    }

    const needed_input = requiredStridedLen(n_rows, input_row_stride, normalized_shape) orelse return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    const needed_output = requiredStridedLen(n_rows, output_row_stride, normalized_shape) orelse return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    if (input.len < needed_input) return NormError.SizeMismatch;
    if (output.len < needed_output) return NormError.SizeMismatch;

    const eps_f64: f64 = @floatCast(eps);
    if (!(eps_f64 > 0.0)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;

    const n_f64: f64 = @floatFromInt(normalized_shape);

    var row: usize = 0;
    while (row < n_rows) : (row += 1) {
        const input_row_start = row * input_row_stride;
        const output_row_start = row * output_row_stride;

        var sum: f64 = 0.0;
        var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < normalized_shape) : (i += 1) {
            const x: f64 = @floatCast(input[input_row_start + i].toFloat());
            sum += x;
            sum_sq += x * x;
        }

        const mean = sum / n_f64;
        const mean_of_squares = sum_sq / n_f64;
        const variance_unclamped = mean_of_squares - mean * mean;
        const variance = @max(0.0, variance_unclamped);
        const inv_std = 1.0 / math.sqrt(variance + eps_f64);

        if (!math.isFinite(inv_std)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;

        i = 0;
        while (i < normalized_shape) : (i += 1) {
            const x: f64 = @floatCast(input[input_row_start + i].toFloat());
            const w: f64 = @floatCast(weight[i].toFloat());
            const b: f64 = if (bias) |bs| @floatCast(bs[i].toFloat()) else 0.0;
            const y = (x - mean) * inv_std * w + b;
            if (!math.isFinite(y)) return NormError.NumericalInstability;
            output[output_row_start + i] = BFloat16.fromFloat(@floatCast(y));
        }
    }
}

A Zig kódodban vannak strided (lépésközös) memóriaműveletek, amik nagyon okosak, de a Lean kódodban csak egyszerű 1D vektorokat (Vec Float n) modellezel.
